question: Who among the following was appointed as the MD and CEO of HDFC Mutual Fund in November 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Navneet Munot.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **CEO and MD **of HDFC Asset Management Company Limited is** Mr. Navneet Munot.**
 
• In the financial markets, Mr. Munot has more than** 28 years of experience**.
 
• He has held the positions of **Chief Investment Officer **at** SBI Mutual Funds**, E**xecutive Director and Head of Multi-Strategy Boutique** at **Morgan Stanley Investment Management**, and CIO for fixed income and hybrid funds at **Birla Sun Life Mutual Funds**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **VK Yadav:**

 
 
• He is the** administrator of Delhi Gymkhana Club Limited.**
 
• He is the** Ex Chairman & CEO** of **Railway Board, Indian Railways.**
 
 
 
• **TN Manoharan**:
 
 
• He is **former president** of the** Institute of Chartered Accountants of India** and **Ex-chairman of Canara Bank.**
 
 
 
• **Rajiv Kumar:**
 
 
• He is the** 25th Chief Election Commissioner of India.**
